digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler — summary write retry and recovery
propositions: Jira lacks idempotency keys; nested SDK/wrapper retries can multiply writes or leave acceptance ambiguous, requiring one provider-neutral retry budget with observe-before-replay semantics.
Cloud and DC summary-only writes must complete within three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, with exact GET/PUT/GET sequencing for DC and one ACLI process per Cloud write.

A desired-state observation after timeout is recovered success; conclusive old state permits replay within remaining budget; failed/rate-limited/inconclusive observations return non-replaying commit_unknown.
The DC executor must pass max_retries=0 to jira.JIRA and fail fast unless _session.max_retries==0, validated offline against the real jira 3.10.5 library before executor logic layers on it.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome emits exactly one redacted completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one message ≤512 code points, with no baseline/provenance advance or S1 deferral persistence.

The constructor-injected internal route selector defaults to legacy (not config/env), tests explicitly select the executor, and S3 owns venue-gated validation and cutover; mixed fields remain one legacy call with no dual-send.
